hero.title: Distributed Market Intelligence

hero.tagline: A real-time, job-tracked quantitative pipeline that processes equity data at scale — with live WebSocket updates, formal QA validation, and seamless demo/live modes.

whatItIs.label: 01 — What It Is
whatItIs.title: A pipeline that doesn't just compute — it validates in real time.
whatItIs.body: A full-stack AI-ready data engineering project that ingests real equity market data, computes key quantitative features using a distributed PySpark pipeline, validates every output through a formal QA system, and streams live execution status via WebSocket.

aiExpertise.intro: This project is deliberately architected as a complete AI-powered quantitative platform. Here’s my depth across the three core pillars.

features.name: Seamless Demo ↔ Live Mode
features.desc: Same UI, zero code change. Works instantly on Vercel (demo) or connected to real Spark backend (live).

features.name: QA Validation System
features.desc: Every Spark output benchmarked against Pandas/SciPy with relative error thresholds and an alignment score (>95% target).

problems.d: Data doesn't stay small. Pandas breaks at scale — PySpark handles millions of rows across tickers without breaking a sweat.
Rolling metrics like volatility and drawdown are expensive to compute correctly. Window functions need care — especially drawdown's unbounded cumulative max.
No one validates whether the numbers are actually right. This project does — with a formal QA layer that scores alignment against a trusted benchmark.
Most pipelines are black boxes. This one streams live status via WebSocket so you can see exactly what’s happening at every step.

aiFullStackExpertise.title: AI & Predictive Intelligence
aiFullStackExpertise.desc: Extending the PySpark pipeline with MLlib and future Torch models for predictive signals and anomaly detection.
highlights: Built modular feature store ready for ML training
QA layer designed to benchmark both classical quant metrics AND ML model outputs
Momentum & volatility features engineered to feed directly into LSTM/Transformer forecasters
Anomaly detection hook using isolation forest (planned Phase 6)

aiFullStackExpertise.title: Full-Stack Orchestration
aiFullStackExpertise.desc: End-to-end ownership: React dashboard ↔ FastAPI backend ↔ distributed Spark engine.
highlights: Seamless demo ↔ live mode switching via env/config
Subdomain deployment (app. + api.) with CORS-ready FastAPI
